svg.title: The covariance here is the rescaled covariance z−2Q, since scaling variables by z and Wick contrac- tion commute with that change of covariance. The band estimate gHk ≤2θk implies |(z−2Q)αβ| ≤ε when |Qαβ| ≤B and 4B ≤Hk. Choose a = [4(n + 2)]−1, B = Ha k, ε = H−1 k . The original threshold obeys θk ≤H−1 k eventually.
